# Code Anchors: Conformance Gate

- `.claude/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the gate's producer: inline findings, the receipt as the command's only write, the contractual placement rule (ephemeral area / committed entry / published review), the stamped record reference and full hash, and the blocked-run-emits-nothing rule.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.close.md` — Phase 1.2: reads the receipt before mining anything, classifies missing / stale-code / stale-record / blocking, requires an explicit per-axis waiver, and restates the verdict in the close comment's conformance line and machine block.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-record-digest/scripts/record_digest.ts` — the digest program the receipt's record hash is taken from and re-verified against.
